meta.name: caveman-commit
meta.description: Write a Conventional Commits message compressed to intent only. Use for "write a commit", "commit message", /commit or /caveman-commit.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 浓缩代码改动为一句提交信息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常为提交信息措辞犯难,希望留下清晰记录。
copy.tagline_en: Condense code changes into one commit message
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often struggle with commit messages and want clean history.

howto.what: 把改动按 Conventional Commits 写成简短提交信息:一行 type 加祈使句摘要,必要时用正文写清原因、破坏性变更或关联 issue;输出成代码块,不执行 git 提交。
howto.when: 说“写个 commit”“commit message”或敲 /commit、/caveman-commit 时触发;“stop caveman-commit”“normal mode”则恢复原有风格。

howto.what_en: Generates a terse Conventional Commits message compressed to intent. Include subject only until body is needed for why/breaking/migration/issues. Output as code block; never runs git commit, stage, or amend.
howto.when_en: Triggered by "write a commit", "commit message", /commit, or /caveman-commit. Saying "stop caveman-commit" or "normal mode" reverts to verbose style.

say_en.note: Handles breaking API note in body.
